g.text: A count can stay right while a value changes
Before · recorded by the older image
Ana sells 0.350 kg cheese at €22.00/kg: €7.70. Coffee €2.20 and wine €3.63 make €13.53. Keep the staff, customer and kitchen names distinct. Freeze
the returned ids and recorded times.
Open a disposable copy through the candidate start path. Compare the saved facts, record ids and stored fiscal bytes. The candidate cannot write its
Cheese quantity: expected 350 thousandths; got 35. The row count is unchanged, but the comparison fails by the original line id. Stop the release; do not
The live cheese price is now €24.00/kg. On a second copy, a new 0.350 kg sale should be €8.40. Yesterday’s line must remain €7.70 with its old name
Illustrative review board. No implementation is approved.
